explanations: recipientFor compares the environment name with == , which tests reference identity, not content. The name comes out of AppConfig.fromEnv as a string read from the process environment (and trimmed or lower-cased), so it is a different object from the interned literal "production" and the comparison is false: production mail is redirected to the sandbox. subjectFor uses equals and works, which is why the subjects looked right. The fix uses equals.
